title: Minimum Swaps to Group All Ones
description: Given a binary array `nums`, group all its ones into one contiguous segment using swaps of any two positions. Return the minimum number of swaps. Input: `nums`. Output: the minimum swaps, or 0 if there are no ones.
hints: Track the running prefix, window, or frequency information needed by the condition.
Check duplicates, all-equal values, and boundary-sized windows.
